bhe.article: All-German Bloc/League of Expellees and Deprived of Rights

source.name: Wikipedia, citing the Federal Returning Officer (Bundeswahlleiter)

elections.notes: CDU/CSU combines the CDU (5,978,636 votes, 25.19%, 115 seats) and the CSU (1,380,448 votes, 5.82%, 24 seats). Single vote: each voter had one vote, counted for both constituency and list seats. Seats exclude the 8 non-voting West Berlin delegates (5 SPD, 2 CDU, 1 FDP), as in the table's footnote. The Saar Protectorate did not take part. No seat changes (first Bundestag). Turnout from the table's electorate and invalid votes. Only West Germany voted: the eleven western states of the time, three of which merged into Baden-Württemberg in 1952. The article has seats by state but no list votes by state, so no region winners.

elections.notes: CDU/CSU combines the CDU (10,016,594 votes, 36.36%, 197 seats, +80) and the CSU (2,427,387 votes, 8.81%, 52 seats, +28). Votes and shares are second (party-list) votes; seats are total seats. Seats are the table's Total column: 487 elected plus 22 non-voting West Berlin members chosen by the Berlin legislature (CDU 6, SPD 11, FDP 5); West Berlin had no direct vote. The +/- column is on the same basis. Only West Germany voted: the nine western states (the Saarland joined in 1957). The article has seats by state but no list votes by state, so no region winners.

Votes and shares are second (party-list) votes; seats are total seats. First election of reunified Germany. The +/- column compares with the Bundestag after East German members were co-opted in October 1990. For this election the 5% threshold applied separately in the West and East, so The Greens (West) won no seats while Alliance 90/Greens (East) won 8.
